description: This file contains utility functions for handling picklist fields within the vtiger CRM, including retrieving picklist values, modules, roles, and related data.
external_files: shared utility functions for language string translation

methods.name: getUserFldArray
methods.description: Retrieves picklist field details for a given module and role, including labels and picklist values.

methods.name: getPickListModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that have picklist fields available.

methods.name: getrole2picklist
methods.description: Retrieves all roles in the CRM except the role with ID 'H1', for populating role-based picklist options.

methods.name: get_available_module_picklist
methods.description: Returns an array of picklist labels for a module, optionally translated.

methods.name: getAllPickListValues
methods.description: Fetches all picklist options for a specific field across the database.

methods.name: getEditablePicklistValues
methods.description: Retrieves all editable picklist values for a specific field.

methods.name: getNonEditablePicklistValues
methods.description: Retrieves non-editable picklist values for a specific field.

methods.name: getAssignedPicklistValues
methods.description: Gets picklist values assigned to a specific role for a picklist tablename, considering subordinate roles.
